---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m2p6t2 ---------------------------
(* Two OR-scheduling coordinators share one pool and take turns via epoch   *)
(* numbers. Each reservation is a two-phase commit begun under some epoch.  *)
(* When a new coordinator takes over the epoch advances, making in-flight   *)
(* transactions from the old epoch stale. A stale coordinator must never    *)
(* commit: no unauthorized, out-of-epoch commit is allowed.                 *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Txns, Participants, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES currentEpoch, txnEpoch, tstate, votes, commitEpoch

vars == <<currentEpoch, txnEpoch, tstate, votes, commitEpoch>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ currentEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ txnEpoch \in [Txns -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ tstate \in [Txns -> {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}]
    /\ votes \in [Txns -> SUBSET Participants]
    /\ commitEpoch \in [Txns -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ currentEpoch = 0
    /\ txnEpoch = [t \in Txns |-> 0]
    /\ tstate = [t \in Txns |-> "idle"]
    /\ votes = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ commitEpoch = [t \in Txns |-> 0]

Begin(t) ==
    /\ tstate[t] = "idle"
    /\ tstate' = [tstate EXCEPT ![t] = "voting"]
    /\ txnEpoch' = [txnEpoch EXCEPT ![t] = currentEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, votes, commitEpoch>>

Vote(t, p) ==
    /\ tstate[t] = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = votes[t] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, txnEpoch, tstate, commitEpoch>>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ tstate[t] = "voting"
    /\ votes[t] = Participants
    /\ txnEpoch[t] = currentEpoch
    /\ tstate' = [tstate EXCEPT ![t] = "committed"]
    /\ commitEpoch' = [commitEpoch EXCEPT ![t] = currentEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, txnEpoch, votes>>

Abort(t) ==
    /\ tstate[t] = "voting"
    /\ (votes[t] # Participants \/ txnEpoch[t] # currentEpoch)
    /\ tstate' = [tstate EXCEPT ![t] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, txnEpoch, votes, commitEpoch>>

NewCoordinator ==
    /\ currentEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ currentEpoch' = currentEpoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txnEpoch, tstate, votes, commitEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Begin(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Participants : Vote(t, p)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Abort(t)
    \/ NewCoordinator

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* Every committed reservation was committed under the same epoch it began  *)
(* in: no stale, out-of-epoch coordinator ever commits.                     *)
NoStaleCommit ==
    \A t \in Txns :
        tstate[t] = "committed" => commitEpoch[t] = txnEpoch[t]

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Txns = {t1, t2}
    Participants = {p1, p2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleCommit
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler is run by two coordinators that share one pool of resources and take turns holding authority, which is tracked by an epoch number. Each surgery reservation is carried out as a two-phase commit that is stamped, when it begins, with the epoch that was current at the time. Participants then vote on the reservation. A reservation may commit only if all participants have voted to approve and the epoch it was begun under is still the current epoch. When authority passes to a new coordinator, the current epoch advances; any transaction that had begun under the previous epoch is now stale and, rather than committing, must abort. This prevents an out-of-date coordinator from finalizing a reservation it is no longer authorized to complete. The safety requirement is that no stale, out-of-epoch transaction is ever committed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, every committed reservation was committed under the same epoch in which it began, so no stale or unauthorized coordinator ever commits.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m6p2t2 ---------------------------
(* Two blood banks share one pool of blood units held across leased         *)
(* fridges. A bank must hold a valid (unexpired) lease on a fridge to        *)
(* withdraw a unit into transit or deposit an in-transit unit. Leases        *)
(* expire as a clock advances. Units are conserved: fridge contents plus    *)
(* in-transit units always sum to the fixed total.                          *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Fridges, NoBank, LeaseLen, MaxTime

ASSUME NoBank \notin Banks

RECURSIVE Sigma(_, _)
Sigma(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + Sigma(f, S \ {x})

TotalUnits == Cardinality(Fridges)

VARIABLES clock, lease, expiry, content, inTransit

vars == <<clock, lease, expiry, content, inTransit>>

LeaseValid(bk, fr) == lease[fr] = bk /\ clock < expiry[fr]

TypeInv ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ lease \in [Fridges -> Banks \cup {NoBank}]
    /\ expiry \in [Fridges -> 0..MaxTime]
    /\ content \in [Fridges -> 0..TotalUnits]
    /\ inTransit \in 0..TotalUnits

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ lease = [fr \in Fridges |-> NoBank]
    /\ expiry = [fr \in Fridges |-> 0]
    /\ content = [fr \in Fridges |-> 1]
    /\ inTransit = 0

AcquireLease(bk, fr) ==
    /\ (lease[fr] = NoBank \/ clock >= expiry[fr])
    /\ clock + LeaseLen <= MaxTime
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![fr] = bk]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![fr] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, content, inTransit>>

Withdraw(bk, fr) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(bk, fr)
    /\ content[fr] >= 1
    /\ content' = [content EXCEPT ![fr] = content[fr] - 1]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, expiry>>

Deposit(bk, fr) ==
    /\ LeaseValid(bk, fr)
    /\ inTransit >= 1
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit - 1
    /\ content' = [content EXCEPT ![fr] = content[fr] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, expiry>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, expiry, content, inTransit>>

Expire(fr) ==
    /\ lease[fr] # NoBank
    /\ clock >= expiry[fr]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![fr] = NoBank]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, content, inTransit>>

Next ==
    \/ \E bk \in Banks, fr \in Fridges : AcquireLease(bk, fr)
    \/ \E bk \in Banks, fr \in Fridges : Withdraw(bk, fr)
    \/ \E bk \in Banks, fr \in Fridges : Deposit(bk, fr)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E fr \in Fridges : Expire(fr)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* Blood units are conserved across both banks: the units resting in        *)
(* fridges plus the units in transit always equal the fixed total.          *)
UnitConservation == Sigma(content, Fridges) + inTransit = TotalUnits

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {ba, bb}
    Fridges = {fr1, fr2}
    NoBank = nob
    LeaseLen = 1
    MaxTime = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitConservation
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
Two blood banks share a single pool of blood units that are physically stored across a set of refrigerators. To move units, a bank must own a refrigerator through a lease: it acquires a lease on a fridge that is free or whose lease has expired, stamped with an expiry time derived from a global clock. Only a bank holding a currently valid, unexpired lease on a fridge may withdraw a unit from that fridge into transit or deposit an in-transit unit back into it. As the clock ticks forward, leases reach their expiry and are released so another bank can take over the fridge. Because both banks operate on the same shared population of units, the units must be conserved at all times: no unit is ever created or lost. Every unit is always either resting inside some fridge or being carried in transit between fridges.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the number of units resting in fridges plus the number of units in transit equals the fixed total number of units, so units are neither created nor destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m3p1t2 ---------------------------
(* Two OR-scheduling pools share one patient record. Each pool elects a     *)
(* leader (with failover on leader crash); only an alive leader may update  *)
(* the record. Updates use read-then-write with a compare check so no       *)
(* update is ever lost: the record value equals the count of applied        *)
(* writes, which holds exactly when no write overwrites another.            *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, PoolANodes, NoNode, MaxWrites

ASSUME PoolANodes \subseteq Nodes
ASSUME NoNode \notin Nodes

Pools == {"pa", "pb"}
PoolOf(nd) == IF nd \in PoolANodes THEN "pa" ELSE "pb"

VARIABLES recVal, appliedWrites, leader, alive, nphase, readVal

vars == <<recVal, appliedWrites, leader, alive, nphase, readVal>>

IsLeader(nd) == \E pl \in Pools : leader[pl] = nd

TypeInv ==
    /\ recVal \in 0..MaxWrites
    /\ appliedWrites \in 0..MaxWrites
    /\ leader \in [Pools -> Nodes \cup {NoNode}]
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ nphase \in [Nodes -> {"idle", "read"}]
    /\ readVal \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxWrites]

Init ==
    /\ recVal = 0
    /\ appliedWrites = 0
    /\ leader = [pl \in Pools |-> NoNode]
    /\ alive = [nd \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ nphase = [nd \in Nodes |-> "idle"]
    /\ readVal = [nd \in Nodes |-> 0]

Elect(pl, nd) ==
    /\ leader[pl] = NoNode
    /\ PoolOf(nd) = pl
    /\ alive[nd]
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![pl] = nd]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVal, appliedWrites, alive, nphase, readVal>>

FailLeader(pl) ==
    /\ leader[pl] # NoNode
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![leader[pl]] = FALSE]
    /\ nphase' = [nphase EXCEPT ![leader[pl]] = "idle"]
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![pl] = NoNode]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVal, appliedWrites, readVal>>

Recover(nd) ==
    /\ ~alive[nd]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![nd] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVal, appliedWrites, leader, nphase, readVal>>

ReadRec(nd) ==
    /\ IsLeader(nd)
    /\ alive[nd]
    /\ nphase[nd] = "idle"
    /\ nphase' = [nphase EXCEPT ![nd] = "read"]
    /\ readVal' = [readVal EXCEPT ![nd] = recVal]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recVal, appliedWrites, leader, alive>>

WriteRec(nd) ==
    /\ IsLeader(nd)
    /\ alive[nd]
    /\ nphase[nd] = "read"
    /\ readVal[nd] = recVal
    /\ appliedWrites < MaxWrites
    /\ recVal' = readVal[nd] + 1
    /\ appliedWrites' = appliedWrites + 1
    /\ nphase' = [nphase EXCEPT ![nd] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, readVal>>

Next ==
    \/ \E pl \in Pools, nd \in Nodes : Elect(pl, nd)
    \/ \E pl \in Pools : FailLeader(pl)
    \/ \E nd \in Nodes : Recover(nd)
    \/ \E nd \in Nodes : ReadRec(nd)
    \/ \E nd \in Nodes : WriteRec(nd)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No update is lost: the shared record's value equals the number of        *)
(* applied writes, which can hold only if every write built on the latest.  *)
NoLostUpdates == recVal = appliedWrites

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {na, nb, nc}
    PoolANodes = {na, nb}
    NoNode = nono
    MaxWrites = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler is served by two scheduling pools that share a single patient record. Each pool elects a leader node, and only the current, alive leader of a pool may update the shared record; if a leader crashes, its pool loses its leader and can elect a replacement (failover), and a crashed node may later recover. To update the record without losing anyone else's changes, a leader first reads the record's current value and then writes back an incremented value, but the write is only accepted if the value it read still matches the record's current value at write time. This read-then-write discipline guarantees that a leader working from an out-of-date read cannot overwrite a change made in the meantime. As a result, every accepted write advances the record by exactly one, and the record's value stays equal to the number of writes that have been applied. No committed update is ever silently discarded by a later write built on stale data.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the shared record's value equals the number of applied writes, so no update to the record is ever lost.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m5p0t4 ---------------------------
(* A vending machine network grants exclusive maintenance locks on machines *)
(* by quorum voting: a technician requests a lock, a quorum of controllers  *)
(* must approve, and only then is the exclusive lock granted (subject to a  *)
(* global maintenance-capacity cap that changes at runtime). At most one    *)
(* technician may hold the maintenance lock on a machine.                   *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, Techs, Controllers, Quorum, MaxCap, NoTech

ASSUME NoTech \notin Techs

VARIABLES pendingTech, votes, held, underMaint, cap

vars == <<pendingTech, votes, held, underMaint, cap>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ pendingTech \in [Machines -> Techs \cup {NoTech}]
    /\ votes \in [Machines -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ held \in [Machines -> SUBSET Techs]
    /\ underMaint \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ pendingTech = [m \in Machines |-> NoTech]
    /\ votes = [m \in Machines |-> {}]
    /\ held = [m \in Machines |-> {}]
    /\ underMaint = 0
    /\ cap = MaxCap

Request(m, tk) ==
    /\ pendingTech[m] = NoTech
    /\ held[m] = {}
    /\ pendingTech' = [pendingTech EXCEPT ![m] = tk]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, held, underMaint, cap>>

Vote(m, ctl) ==
    /\ pendingTech[m] # NoTech
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = votes[m] \cup {ctl}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingTech, held, underMaint, cap>>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ pendingTech[m] # NoTech
    /\ Cardinality(votes[m]) >= Quorum
    /\ held[m] = {}
    /\ underMaint < cap
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = {pendingTech[m]}]
    /\ underMaint' = underMaint + 1
    /\ pendingTech' = [pendingTech EXCEPT ![m] = NoTech]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Release(m) ==
    /\ held[m] # {}
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ underMaint' = underMaint - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingTech, votes, cap>>

RaiseCap ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingTech, votes, held, underMaint>>

LowerCap ==
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingTech, votes, held, underMaint>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines, tk \in Techs : Request(m, tk)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, ctl \in Controllers : Vote(m, ctl)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Grant(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Release(m)
    \/ RaiseCap
    \/ LowerCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* At most one technician holds the maintenance lock on any machine.        *)
MaintLockExclusive ==
    \A m \in Machines : \A t1, t2 \in held[m] : t1 = t2

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2}
    Techs = {tk1, tk2}
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    NoTech = notk
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MaintLockExclusive
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A vending machine network coordinates maintenance across its machines by handing out exclusive maintenance locks through quorum voting. When a technician wants to service a machine, it files a request for that machine's maintenance lock, provided the machine is free and has no request already pending. A set of network controllers then vote on the request. Once a quorum of controllers has approved, and provided the machine is still unlocked and the network is below its global cap on how many machines may be under maintenance at once, the lock is granted exclusively to the requesting technician. When the technician finishes, it releases the lock. The global maintenance capacity cap rises and falls at runtime as network conditions change. The essential safety guarantee is that a machine's maintenance lock is exclusive: no two technicians may hold the maintenance lock on the same machine at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, at most one technician holds the maintenance lock on any given machine.
